# Shotscreen Browser

> Shotscreen Browser is a frameless desktop browser for clean website screenshots on macOS, built with Electron and Vue. It has viewport presets, full-page capture, rounded corners, forced dark mode and cookie banner hiding.

Download the macOS build from https://github.com/halitsever/shotscreen/releases and move it to Applications. Gatekeeper blocks the first launch, so run `xattr -cr "/Applications/Shotscreen Browser.app"` once. Press Cmd+Shift+S to capture.

## Docs

- [Guide](https://projects.halit.org/shotscreen/): the interface, viewport presets, capture modes and options, corner radius settings, shot history and the keyboard shortcut
- [Download](https://projects.halit.org/shotscreen/download.html): where to download and how to get past Gatekeeper on first launch
- [Website screenshot online](https://projects.halit.org/shotscreen/website-screenshot/): paste a URL and get a PNG of the page in the browser, through the free shared shotsnap endpoint (7 requests per 10 minutes per IP address, about 1,000 a day, HTTP 429 after that)
- [Blog](https://projects.halit.org/shotscreen/blog/): Mac screenshot guides: every shortcut, where screenshots are saved, cropping, full-page captures in Safari, Chrome and Firefox, higher resolution screenshots, Print Screen on a Mac, whether websites can detect screenshots, the Snipping Tool equivalent on Mac, copying and pasting screenshots, fixing screenshots that do not work, deleting screenshots, viewing the mobile version of a website and screenshots on a MacBook
